title: Phase Diffuser
pages: A fourth t9 apparatus. Craft it with a Sublimated Phase, four sealed steel plates, two glass panes, a hopper and a Phase Sublimator.

Feed one item into the left slot. The diffuser spends 20 FE/t for 150 ticks and yields a single sealed result in the right slot; like the Phase Sublimator there is no second byproduct channel. Diffusing two Sublimated Phase yields the Diffused Phase, one of the five t9 materials the Phase Annealer's recipe converges on.

Twenty datapack recipes cover sculk, amethyst, prismarine, nether-growth and other late-game reprocessing into dense alternate forms. Diffusion obeys the material-trait rule with no field: a product may only carry the traits of count x its input, so a composite spreads back only into the part it was built around. A calibrated sculk sensor (resonant 5, the relay field it was tuned in; no crystal strength) covers two sculk sensors, a glow item frame keeps its glow ink sac's signature, a honeycomb block (waxen 3, binding 1) covers honey, prismarine masonry carries a faint glow (luminous 1) released as shards and crystals, nether and warped wart blocks share the nylium heat (fiery 1), and two Sublimated Phase (luminous 1, resonant 1 each) cover the Diffused Phase. Four nether wart blocks diffuse into two crimson fungi, since soul soil's umbral trait is not in the wart. A datapack row whose product needs other traits, such as a poppy becoming glowstone dust, pauses on status "unexplained_traits" without spending FE. One glow item frame diffuses into one glow ink sac, matching the sac used by composition with an ordinary item frame and below the two sacs needed for Etching. One budding amethyst diffuses into two amethyst clusters; tumbling those returns eight shards, one fewer than the nine the Phase Collapser needs to rebuild the budding block. JEI displays the result and FE. Recipe type arcana_industry:diffusion accepts ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Higher priority wins; equal priority uses recipe ID.

Top and horizontal sides import; bottom exports the result. Side mode buttons configure each face. Supply FE by capability or manual crank. The machine pauses if the output slot is full; inventory, FE, work progress and side modes persist. Breaking it drops both slots. The Phase Annealer now requires one Diffused Phase in its top-right corner instead of a third sealed steel plate.
